values.question: Can the current separate actor/critic LSTM learn effective stock-game defense against the fixed standard FSM attacker?
values.training_topology_seeds: 0..99, stock generator, unchanged subnet scaffold and game rules
values.primary_evaluation: Last planned checkpoint versus initialization under fixed stock FSM, averaged equally over the four reserved stock layouts and 16 episode roots per layout, with separate results for each training seed.
values.secondary_evaluation: Same checkpoints against four fixed archived learned Reds. These related archive opponents are excluded from new Blue training but are not a verified independent holdout population.
values.selection: Use the explicitly selected successful attempt and its initial and final planned checkpoints. Retain failed/cancelled attempts and partial checkpoints as incomplete; never substitute a best-scoring checkpoint. Smoke is excluded from scientific replicate and episode counts.
values.stop_rule: Budget-limited training; no outcome-based stopping or tuning. All allocated work ends before 2026-11-09T13:00:00Z (Monday 08:00 America/New_York).
values.comparison_limit: Historical co-trained policies are contextual references because exact historical training source is unavailable. This diagnostic does not identify the causal effect of co-training or nonstationarity, nor establish SOTA.
